d: Rajy men esaaaeeaar ki prakriya ke tahat patr matdataon ko antim matdata suchi men nam shamil karane ka ek aur avsar diya ja raha hai. iske lie rajy ke sabhi matdan kendron par ek aur avsar kainp ka aayojan kiya gaya, jahan mukhy nirvachan padadhikari ke. ravi kumar ne ranchi men vibhinn buthon ka nirikshan kar vyavasthaon ka jayja liya. vahin, rajy men esaaaeeaar ki samay sima ek bar phir barha di gaee hai. ab antim matdata suchi ka prakashan 22 disanbar ko kiya jaega. idhar, mukhyamantri hemant soren ki adhyakshata men aaj rajy mantrimandal ki baithak hogi. baithak men sarkari…
